purpose: A CLI Circular multi-record canvas of two one-record files whose Record Order names each record by record ID (OV-3313 review 2 M2): no record has a selector, so Load reads each record's ID from its file
writer: gbdraw/circular.py --save_session (CLI sidecar), run from the fix/record-order-row-one-rule worktree on PYTHONPATH
command: PYTHONPATH=<worktree> python -c 'from gbdraw.cli import main; main()' circular --gbk b_collide.gb regex_rules.gb --multi_record_canvas --multi_record_position 'REGEX.1@1' --multi_record_position 'TESTA@2' --save_session -o cli-circular-record-order
workingDirectory: a scratch folder; the inputs are tests/fixtures/b_collide.gb and tests/fixtures/regex_rules.gb
